name: Patients Care Medical Supply Inc
description: is proudly based in Maurice, Louisiana, and serves Lafayette, Youngsville, Broussard, Abbeville, New Iberia, and surrounding Acadiana communities with compassionate, reliable medical equipment and personalized support. As a locally owned and operated provider of durable medical equipment (DME) near Lafayette, LA, we offer a comprehensive selection of products, including mobility aids, wheelchairs, walkers, CPAP and respiratory therapy equipment, bathroom safety products, and home health essentials. Our experienced team understands that every patient's needs are unique, which is why we take the time to provide knowledgeable guidance, fast service, and ongoing support. Whether you're a patient recovering at home, a family caregiver, or a healthcare professional seeking trusted equipment solutions, we're committed to treating you like family and helping you maintain comfort, independence, and quality of life. And if you're driving in to visit us, remember to ease off that gas pedal—Maurice is known for friendly service, hometown hospitality, and some very strict speed limits!
